title: Discrete Wasserstein Flows for One-Step Generative Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2610.01355v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a new framework for one-step generative modelling on finite state spaces. To extend drifting beyond continuous domains, we use discrete Wasserstein geometry to define a target-relative KL gradient flow over the transitions of a reversible Markov kernel. We realize this probability flow at the particle level through Markov jumps and amortize the resulting transport updates into a latent-conditioned generator, so that the iterative dynamics are required only during training while inference remains one-step. In a controlled setting where the underlying distributions and transport dynamics can be computed exactly, we verify KL dissipation, consistency between the particle dynamics and the probability flow, and the predicted numerical scaling. translated_title: 用于单步生成建模的离散Wasserstein流
translated_abstract: 我们为有限状态空间上的单步生成建模引入了一个新框架。为了将漂移动力学从连续域扩展到离散域，我们利用离散Wasserstein几何，在可逆马尔可夫核的转移上定义了一个相对于目标的KL梯度流。我们通过马尔可夫跳跃在粒子层面实现这一概率流，并将由此产生的输运更新摊销到一个以潜变量为条件的生成器中，使得迭代动力学仅在训练期间需要，而推理阶段保持单步生成。在一个可以精确计算底层分布和输运动力学的受控环境中，我们验证了KL耗散性、粒子动力学与概率流之间的一致性，以及理论预测的数值缩放规律。我们进一步证明，一个有限容量的神经生成器能够追踪这些精确的输运目标，同时保持单步生成。这些结果验证了基本构造的有效性，并证……（摘要截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一个基于离散Wasserstein几何的新框架，通过将可逆马尔可夫核上KL梯度流的输运更新摊销到潜变量条件生成器中，首次实现了有限状态空间上的单步生成建模，训练仅需迭代动力学而推理保持单步。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a new framework for one-step generative modeling on finite state spaces by amortizing transport updates from a discrete Wasserstein KL gradient flow over reversible Markov kernel transitions into a latent-conditioned generator, requiring iterative dynamics only during training while inference remains one-step.
